# Bruno's Alarm (Bruno's Howl Alarm)

> A free Android alarm clock that wakes you up with a real dog's howl. Bruno is a real dog who howls at a church bell near his home twice a day, at 06:00 and 18:00 India time (IST). A camera streams him live, and his latest recorded howl becomes your alarm sound.

Key facts:

- Platform: Android only (Google Play). No iPhone version yet.
- Price: free. No ads, no sign-up, no account.
- It rings like the phone's normal alarm, even on silent or Do Not Disturb, and shows Bruno full screen.
- Any number of alarms: once, every day, weekdays, or chosen days. Snooze is available.
- The howl recording is saved on the phone, so alarms ring without an internet connection and even if Bruno skips a session.
- Live: watch Bruno around 06:00 and 18:00 IST, or turn on "Ring when Bruno goes live" to be alerted when he's on camera.
- "Watch his last howl" replays his newest session; users rate each howl from 1 to 5 paws and see the shared average.
- Made by one independent developer (Bruno's owner). Publisher name on Google Play: Treepie.
